intro: Competitive programming helps me become a more thoughtful problem solver. I enjoy exploring algorithms, working through challenging problems, and improving the way I reason about solutions.
journey: My interest in problem solving grew as I moved from web development into C++, data structures, and algorithms. Competitive programming gave me a structured way to practice logical thinking, understand constraints, and learn from mistakes.
approach: I try to understand why a solution works, not just whether it passes. When I struggle with a problem, I revisit the underlying concepts, study alternative approaches, and look for ways to improve my reasoning.
